summary: Portfolio regression testing passed navigation, anchors, hero motion, reduced-motion fallback, resume URL, filters, project detail, mobile menu/overflow, valid contact submission, and honeypot rejection. Rate-limit verification failed because repeated requests were distributed across workers.

critical.issue: The documented 3-attempt/5-minute limit is not reliable: four sequential requests returned [200, 200, 429, 200]. The in-memory contact_attempts dictionary is process-local and appears inconsistent across backend workers.

action_items: Move contact rate-limit state to shared persistent storage (MongoDB or a shared rate-limit service), then retest across workers.
Remove visible 01 / AI IMAGE + VIDEO experiment label and any remaining whole-page numbering if the requirement applies globally.
critical_code_review_comments: Process-local rate limiting cannot enforce a public API limit when multiple backend workers serve requests.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_-prefixed contact submissions during API regression; no seeded production records were modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop and mobile portfolio flows passed. Recheck shared rate limiting with four sequential requests and confirm all visible numbering is removed.
rca of the issue: contact_attempts is a module-level Python dictionary. With multiple backend processes/workers, each process maintains separate timestamps, allowing requests routed to another worker to bypass the threshold.
